segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hey Dana, thanks for making the time. I saw your note about expanding the analytics workspace before the September planning cycle. Is the ask still 42 additional seats?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, 42 is right. We have 118 today, so that would put us at 160 total. The main thing is we need the new managers live by August 19.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay, that date is workable. For the additional 42 seats, co-termed to your current agreement through May 31, the prorated amount is $18,480. That keeps the same per-seat rate you have now.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. And that can be invoiced as a separate line, not blended into the May renewal invoice?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, separate invoice for the expansion. Net 30, same billing contact, accounts.payable at your company domain, unless you want that changed.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, keep it there. Procurement will ask whether there is any implementation fee with this.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No implementation fee for this seat add. We include one 60-minute admin refresh session, and then your customer success manager will send the manager onboarding guide after the order is signed.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. We also need the seats assigned in two batches. First 25 on August 12, remaining 17 on August 19. Is that a problem?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No, that's fine. The order will show 42 seats effective August 12 for billing, and we can set the access rollout in those two batches.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send me the order form today if you can. I can route it for signature this afternoon.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll send the order form with the $18,480 total, May 31 co-term, separate invoice, and the two access dates called out. Anything else you need on it?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Just include our PO number, PO-44718. If that's on there, we should be good.
